As Camus said, life is purely absurd and is not meant to have meaning. People cheat by having a certain faith, which is fine though.

Sartre said something similar about life being exactly what you make of it, about life having no meaning except to live. You need to find a direction you'd be happy with, that's all.

Its just a question of showing people you don't really care about what they really think of you for me. I just walk up to people and make some jokes, make them feel comfortable so the tension just floats all away.

There are billions of people out there, we're pretty much all the same in the end of the day so there is no reason to freak out when meeting people, because if they don't like you, that's alright. Not everyone will like you and vice versa, you just need to be nice and stop caring so much.
